test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Barbaric
solution:
The correct answer is **Civilised**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym __for the given word '**Barbaric**' is '**Civilised**'.
 
• The meaning of the word '**Barbaric**' is '**primitive; unsophisticated**'.(असभ्य)
 
• The meaning of the word '**Civilised**' is '**polite and well-mannered**'. (सभ्य)
 
• Hence, the **most appropriate** answer is '**Civilised**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **Indifferent**- having no particular interest or sympathy; unconcerned.(उदासीन)
 
• **Brutal**- savage; violent.(क्रूर)
 
• **Inquisitive**- unduly curious about the affairs of others; prying.(जिज्ञासु)
